crates/drivers/cabin-pzem/src/pzem_017.rs — existing driver, cites the same PDF

transport: RS-485 · Modbus RTU · 9600 8N2 · default slave 1 (valid range 0x01–0xF7; 0x00 is broadcast with no reply, 0xF8 is the general address usable only in a single-slave bus)
blocks: Input registers 0x0000–0x0007 read with FC 0x04 (measurement) · holding registers 0x0000–0x0003 read with FC 0x03 and written with FC 0x06 (parameters) · FC 0x42 reset energy (4-byte frame, no register) · FC 0x41 factory calibration, address 0xF8 only, password 0x3721 · CRC-16 poly 0xA001
sharedMapEvidence: One vendor document covers both, by name: docs/pzem-003-017-manual.pdf is titled 'PZEM-003/017 DC communication module' and its section 2.3 gives a single measurement-register table (0x0000 voltage @0.01 V, 0x0001 current @0.01 A, 0x0002/0x0003 power lo/hi @0.1 W, 0x0004/0x0005 energy lo/hi @1 Wh, 0x0006 high-voltage alarm, 0x0007 low-voltage alarm) with no per-model split. The two models are dist
gotchas: Resolutions are not uniform inside one block: voltage and current are hundredths but power is TENTHS, and energy is already whole watt-hours. Assuming one scale for the block reports a 65 W load as 6.5 W.
8N2, not 8N1 — the DC meters are the odd ones out in the whole PZEM line. Framing belongs to the port, so a 017 cannot share a USB-485 adapter with a 016 despite both running 9600.

Holding register 0x0003 (shunt range) defaults to 0x0000 = 100 A. A 50 A shunt left at the default reports half the amps that are flowing, silently and plausibly. Note the encoding is not ascending: 0=100 A, 1=50 A, 2=200 A, 3=300 A.
Every unit leaves the factory at slave address 1. Several on one bus must be readdressed one at a time via holding 0x0002.

Manual §5.1: the RS-485 side is a PASSIVE interface needing an external 5 V supply over 100 mA. §5.2/note: below 7 V input the meter must be fed 5 V through its micro-USB port, and the manual warns in bold not to use a PC's USB port for this.
unmappedReports: High-voltage alarm status (0x0006, 0xFFFF = alarm) — no MetricKind for a device-side alarm flag, Low-voltage alarm status (0x0007, 0xFFFF = alarm) — no MetricKind, High/low voltage alarm thresholds (holding 0x0000/0x0001, 0.01 V) — settable over the wire, no CommandKind covers setting a device threshold, Shunt current range select (holding 0x0003) — settable over the wire, no CommandKind covers it; done out-of-band by the `pzem set-shunt` CLI
